g.text: 100kHz I2C, address 0x68; FIFO polling (INT intentionally NC). 400kHz only after <=300ns rise-time / <=60pF target qualification.

g.desc: 100kHz I2C, address 0x68; FIFO polling (INT intentionally NC). 400kHz only after <=300ns rise-time / <=60pF target qualification.

g.text: Initialize and validate internal AK09916 magnetometer as well as accel/gyro. Startup/rundown and cap-effective checks remain bench gates.

g.desc: Initialize and validate internal AK09916 magnetometer as well as accel/gyro. Startup/rundown and cap-effective checks remain bench gates.

g.text: Carrier axes: +X PH pin1->4; +Y into PCB; +Z component face. U2 pin1 upper-left in top view: accel/gyro (X,Y,Z); mag (X,-Y,-Z).

g.desc: Carrier axes: +X PH pin1->4; +Y into PCB; +Z component face. U2 pin1 upper-left in top view: accel/gyro (X,Y,Z); mag (X,-Y,-Z).

g.text: 18x20x1mm, four layers, fourteen fitted parts. Nonconductive registered peripheral supports; no sensor-area clamping. See interface.json.
